response.block_reason: self-upgrade unsupported for deployment mode docker

frontend_gate_reference.fact: ConfirmDialog only calls handleConfirm (which POSTs /api/nodes/upgrade) on confirm; cancelBtnText is wired to dialog close, so cancelling performs no API call

limitation: UI click-through of the ConfirmDialog cancel path was intentionally NOT executed: the same bulk-upgrade dialog confirms real protected nodes, and a mis-click would replace Agent binaries on protected nodes. Verified at API level + frontend source contract instead.
